items.title: M0 runtime scope and command boundary
items.context: Add a bounded runtime pack surface and one-command evidence-binding checklist command while preserving non-goals from docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-pinn-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md.
items.userSees: User sees: "PINN claim admissibility scope: local claim-control only; PDE correctness=false; productionDone=false".

happy.desc: CLI help exposes PINN claim admissibility commands with local-only/no-PDE-correctness wording.

edge.desc: Commands reject productionDone/authorityDone/PDE-correctness style flags or claims.

adversarial.desc: No command can present PINN evidence as production or scientific correctness proof.

verificationEvidence.note: CLI exposes and executes the local-only PINN claim check, returning allowed=true for complete C9 evidence with all completion/correctness flags false.
CLI validation rejects productionDone overclaim flags with expected-never validation before running the command.
Smoke asserts command/report text never sets productionDone, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or pdeCorrectnessClaim true.

items.title: M1 claim and evidence schema
items.context: Implement versioned PINN claim/evidence schema with required identity fields, deterministic hash binding, and stale/missing/mismatch detection.
items.userSees: User sees deterministic BLOCK reason codes for missing/stale/mismatched PINN evidence.

happy.desc: A complete current evidence bundle passes schema and identity binding checks.

edge.desc: Missing hashes, stale hashes, or mismatched subject hashes block with stable reason codes.

adversarial.desc: Low training loss alone cannot satisfy residual, BC/IC, generalization, baseline, reproducibility, or provenance claims.

verificationEvidence.note: Complete C9 evidence passes schema and identity binding checks with all nine adapter families checked.
B1/B2/B13 fixtures cover missing, stale, and mismatched identity hashes and assert stable fail-closed reason codes.
Low training loss with only spec/training receipts is rejected for C9 with training_loss_not_solution_evidence.

items.title: M2 verifier adapter pack
items.context: Implement deterministic local verifier adapter receipt checks for spec, training, residual, BC, IC, out-of-sample, baseline, reproducibility, and provenance evidence.
items.userSees: User sees adapter-specific fail-closed reason codes when verifier receipts are missing or malformed.

happy.desc: All nine adapter families accept deterministic machine-readable pass receipts bound to the active identity.

edge.desc: Malformed receipts, failed exit codes, wrong verifier hashes, or stale adapter outputs fail closed.

adversarial.desc: A verifier-only arm without lifecycle gate still permits unsupported advancement in the benchmark where A4 blocks it.

items.title: M3 gate transition engine
items.context: Implement fail-closed lifecycle transition evaluation for advance/repair/degrade/stop over the PINN claim path.
items.userSees: User sees nextAction=advance/repair/degrade/stop with explicit reason codes for each PINN lifecycle transition.

happy.desc: A complete evidence path advances through result claim without unsupported transitions.

edge.desc: Repairable missing evidence returns repair/degrade, while unsafe mismatch returns stop.

adversarial.desc: Unsupported claim upgrades are blocked even when narrative self-report/checklist/verifier-only signals pass.

items.title: M4 benchmark harness
items.context: Implement deterministic A1-A4 / B1-B15 benchmark runner with unsupported-advance, stale-evidence, boundary-violation, reproducibility, intervention, and overhead metrics plus confidence intervals.
items.userSees: User sees a reproducible comparison table where A4 rejects all B1-B15 stale/mismatch injections and beats A1/A2/A3 on unsupported advancement.

happy.desc: Benchmark runner reports A1-A4 metrics and Wilson confidence intervals for deterministic fixtures.

edge.desc: A4 rejects every B1-B15 injection while the weaker arms expose nonzero unsupported/stale acceptance rates.

adversarial.desc: Benchmark reports wall-time/intervention overhead instead of hiding costs or claiming PDE performance.

items.title: M5 reporting and governance integration
items.context: Implement report rendering, artifact index, non-claim wording, docs status update, and smoke coverage for governance boundaries.
items.userSees: User sees report wording that says the pack controls claim admissibility and does not prove PDE correctness or improve solver accuracy.

happy.desc: Report command renders artifact index and boundary paragraph from runtime results.

edge.desc: Report remains deterministic and machine-readable in JSON mode.

adversarial.desc: Generated reports never claim PDE correctness, production readiness, or external authority completion.
